Rank 04 - Property

Bariwala and Market Shop Rent Manager

Bariwala and market owners need one place for monthly rent, shop rent, electricity, service charge, advance, due, notice, and receipt.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 8,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 500/month is practical for small landlords. For market owners with many shops, charge BDT 1,000-2,000/month or per 50 tenants because rent collection is high-value.

9.1Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 8,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 14,000,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target bariwala, flat owners, small building owners, market owners, bazar committees, and shop landlords who collect rent every month from tenants.

Rent is collected by cash, bKash, notebook, or memory. Tenants delay payment, receipts are unclear, electricity/service charges are disputed, and the owner cannot see monthly due quickly.

The bariwala sees who paid, who is due, which shop owes electricity, and can send a clean receipt.

Validation signals

  • Retail and repair are the largest economic-unit block, so market/shop rent is a large recurring workflow.
  • Rent receipt and landlord-tenant disputes are known Bangladesh pain points.
  • Rent repeats monthly, which fits subscription software.
  • Market owners and bariwala can pay more than a single tenant because one account manages many units.

MVP modules

  • Tenant and shop list
  • Flat/room/shop rent setup
  • Monthly rent bill
  • Electricity and service charge
  • Advance/security deposit record
  • Payment receipt
  • Due reminder and monthly owner report

Do not build first

  • Do not build a house-rental marketplace first.
  • Do not custody rent money first.
  • Do not add legal eviction tools.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 5 bariwala or market owners.
  • Enter tenant/shop list and monthly rent amount.
  • Generate first month's bills and receipts.
  • Add tenant SMS/WhatsApp due reminder after owner trusts the record.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Owners may not want tenants to see full records.
  • Cash payment creates proof disputes.
  • Each market has custom charges.
Mitigations
  • Owner-only dashboard with optional tenant receipt page.
  • Receipt number and payment note without holding money.
  • Configurable charge types for electricity, service, guard, generator, and market fee.
